messages:
maya: Noticed SCIM syncs to Okta started failing with 401s after last night's KMS envelope rotate. Few tenants affected, looks like token validation failing.

maya: Logs:
```
2026-05-10T02:11:05Z provisioner req=aa11 status=401 err=\"token signature invalid after decrypt\"
2026-05-10T02:11:06Z provisioner req=aa12 status=401 err=\"KMS decrypt returned NotFound\"
```

dan: Which key alias did we rotate and was Secrets Manager updated?

maya: Deploy note: alias/redwood/provisioner-envelope -> alias/redwood/provisioner-envelope-v2 at 02:10. I see secret svc/provisioner/kms still references the old key arn.

ops-bot: deploy infra/kms-rotate completed by zoe at 02:10 UTC :white_check_mark:

zoe: I rotated the key and updated the key alias, I planned to stage the secret update but forgot to flip it. Sorry, will push immediately.

security-oncall: Capture CloudTrail Decrypt results and Secrets Manager PutSecretValue. Tag incident sec-2026-05-10-kms-desync.

dan: Quick mitigation: either re-enable old key decrypt to reduce impact or flip secret now. Which minimizes risk?

maya: Lambdas fetch secrets at cold start so flipping secret should be safe; re-enabling old key is slightly faster though.

zoe: I'll push updated secret with new ARN and version label \"rotate-2026-05-10\" now, then monitor.

security-oncall: Also grep provisioning logs for any duplicated deprovision actions to surface to CS.

zoe: Secret pushed at 02:18 UTC.

maya: Syncs are green for the tenants that were failing. Seeing 200s again.

security-oncall: Grab CloudTrail snippets and schedule a follow-up postmortem. Action: add explicit runbook step to verify Secrets Manager mapping when rotating envelope keys.

dan: I'll add a telemetry field to log obfuscated key-id used per decrypt so future rotations are easier to trace. Small PR incoming.

zoe: Note to self: update rotation playbook to include a pre-flip verify step.

security-oncall: Closing thread, moving artifacts to incident document. :lock:
